assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/fukuga-kozue-manga.md (FXK-P003, version 1.0, 82,875 bytes, status canonical), a self-contained portrait of Fukuga Kozue within the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, claim, decision and open-question IDs, with brief Japanese quotations. The monograph keeps three evidence layers apart and so does this assessment: V01 chapter 1 as reported speech inside her daughter Fukuga Kurumi's retrospective narration; V06 第28話 as a flashback of mixed authority, partly her own dated trading journal (written self-report) and partly narration; and V09 as her husband's late memory and self-report. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision, with twenty-nine re-opened pages. Paratext, later volumes and adaptations are excluded by the monograph itself. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C, the audits and Fukuga Kurumi's monograph that it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Her own life as the page shows it, 1998 to Friday 13 February 2009, in four located phases: before she traded (1998 to May 2006, with undated early-childhood memories of Kurumi); the confident years (May 2006 to July 2008); the loss (2 September to 24 October 2008, with the broker's forced liquidation on 6 October splitting it into averaging-down before and the 400x plan and 100-lot short after); and after exposure (24 October 2008 to 13 February 2009, seen only from outside through Kurumi). V06 and V09 are late revelations that change what the reader knows, not who she was: her motives, journal and marriage's money roles belong to her at every state they predate. Her death on 13 February 2009 ends the subject; V07-V10 can test no prediction about her, and depictions of her after that date are evidence about how Kurumi and her husband hold her. Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Sections 5-6 give stated motives (something of her own, a little money, her husband's surprise, a happier family; V06 i0062-i0071), a drawn craving beside the family dream (i0075), fears (discovery, 一家離散, i0082; shame, i0073, i0087), five named tensions and a coping sequence, with authority labels throughout. The account says what changes her response: ease and passivity read as safety (i0064); gains raise confidence and goals (i0066-i0070); unrealized loss is reframed as a bargain, held and fed from the next pot (i0070-i0077); ruin after the broker's close flips her to haste, 400x sizing aimed at the loss and a reversed direction (i0082-i0084); exposure by her daughter brings words of responsibility, refusal of help, secrecy and work (V01 i0014-i0023). It predicts her mistakes: named danger not acted on (i0072, i0087), protected money taken, concealment never corrected. The family-ideal and craving readings predict the same staking and coexist. Not A: her inner states after October 2008 are seen only through Kurumi, the reasons for her death are not given, and the 13 February turn's intent cannot be decided (section 15). Not C: the account discriminates by phase, stake, knowledge and addressee and states where it stops (section 14).

Section 13 dates six changes inside her life (sceptic to trader, 2005 to May 2006; entrant to believer, to July 2008; open to hidden and own money to everyone's, September 2008; patience to haste after the 6 October liquidation; secrecy shared with one child from 24 October 2008; the last day) and section 4's table separates when something happened, when the reader learns it and what she knew then. Section 2 and section 13 keep V06 and V09 as late revelation, not development, and section 13's afterlife list keeps post-2009 depictions as others' use of her. Not A: the after-exposure phase is a few scenes in Kurumi's retrospective narration with little dating between 24 October 2008 and 13 February 2009, and causes of change are given only through her own and the narrator's accounts. Not C: every state change is located and the phase boundaries are stated with page anchors.

Section 8 constrains her written Japanese for the sampled listeners: feminine standard Japanese with よ, わ, のよね and でしょ endings; gentle 〜なさい and stretched playful vowels to her child; お母さん as parental self-reference and 私 when taking an adult position; くるみちゃん as address throughout, plain くるみ when speaking of her alone; 郁夫さん alone and in the journal, あなた in the remembered quarrel; the one distancing あなた at V01 i0026; rough language only alone at a chart (V01 i0010-i0011), never to a person; soft forms kept while lying (V06 i0073; V01 i0023); the journal's plain dated declaratives turning to trailing dots and scribble; and a three-step apology gradient (ごめんね, ごめんなさい, すみませんでした). Not A: the corpus is lettering in two chapters plus memories, the V01 lines are reported inside Kurumi's narration, and speech to her husband, her parents and her friends is one or two lines each. Not C: the forms and their triggers by listener and pressure are located with several instances each.

Sections 7, 10 and 12 attest ordinary conduct across three layers that agree: the morning send-off kept through the child's rebellion (V06 i0061, i0068), cakes and lunchboxes (i0066, i0068), laundry and vacuuming, praise and patient play in Kurumi's memories (V02 i0111; V05 i0160-i0161; V01 i0037), meals left covered even at her lowest (V01 i0017) and the offer to do the shopping on the last day (i0027). The account changes with phase: household collapse, lies and the unanswered door under the concealed loss (V06 i0073-i0085), paid work and long hours after exposure. Stable preferences are separated from situational choices (section 10). Not A: no leisure, hobby, friend as a named person or content of her 2009 work is shown, and the good years are mostly memory and flashback. Not C: the routines are repeated and their collapse and partial persistence are located by phase.

Section 9 directs and dates each tie. Toward Kurumi: warmth and ritual to mid-2008; lies, silence and neglect in the loss; a secret laid on her with protection from its cost after 24 October 2008; refusal, one sharp turn and immediate concession on 13 February 2009. Toward her husband: objection to his transfers in person (V09 i0072-i0073), a wish to surprise him (V06 i0064-i0065), fear of his discovery and concealment (i0082; V01 i0023, i0026). Toward her parents: one scene of cash taken from their safe (V06 i0077). Toward her mum-friends: comparison and pressure (i0062, i0067). Others' views of her are kept apart. Not A: only the tie to Kurumi is shown changing; the marriage is shown in fixed states through her thoughts, his late memory and her fear, and no direct conversation about money is staged. Not C: the Kurumi tie is a discriminating, dated account and the conditioning by who knows what is explicit.

Interior evidence is real but confined to one period and one mixed-authority chapter: V06's soliloquies, thoughts and dated journal entries give her motives, fears, self-conception and despair from May 2006 to 23 October 2008 (i0062-i0089), with a reliability flag where her own record contradicts her (i0068 against i0070). From 24 October 2008 to 13 February 2009 there is no interiority beyond what Kurumi reports seeing (section 2), and the monograph keeps open her inner states beyond the journal, the intent of the 13 February turn and the reasons for her death (section 15). Not B: the last four months, which contain her refusal to confess and her final act on the page, are seen only from outside through a grieving child's retrospective narration. Not D: for the loss itself the journal and thoughts give a located, labelled inner account.

Sampled conflicts are few: silence before her daughter's reproach in the heaped laundry (V06 i0074); the 13 February confrontation, with refusal (無理よ), one sharp turn with the distancing あなた, immediate concession and withdrawal into an errand (V01 i0026-i0027); objection to her husband's transfers in his memory (V09 i0072-i0073); and fury alone at a chart and an unnamed forecaster (V01 i0010-i0011). Section 14 gives the pattern (soft forms toward persons, rough language only toward the market; concession when accused). Not B: the confrontation is one scene whose intent cannot be decided, and no conflict with her husband in the present is staged. Not D: the pattern across the sampled conflicts is consistent and located.

Section 6 records that her conflicting obligations (her own savings, the household's, the family's future home, her parents' cash; protection against need toward her daughter; honesty against the family's survival toward her husband) were resolved the same way, by taking and not telling, and that the page never shows her weighing them aloud. Her ethical self-assessments are in words: これは私の責任なんだから (V01 i0016), 家族になんて謝ればいいかわからない (V06 i0087), the one-line written apology (V01 i0030). The monograph's accepted grades are negligence without cruelty and a burden laid on a child without manipulation for gain (sections 7, 9). Not B: outcomes are predictable but deliberation is not shown, and her grasp of what the secret asked of a fifteen-year-old is not shown. Not D: the outcome pattern is repeated across four pots and two persons.

Play appears in the good years and in memory: teasing the rebellious middle-schooler (あらあら 反抗期♡ ふふっ, V06 i0061), laughing off her own daydream (なんてねー, i0065), stretched-vowel threats on the beach that she does not carry out (V05 i0160-i0161), praise games with the small child and the arithmetic memory that may be play (V01 i0037; section 12 keeps that reading a hypothesis). None appears from September 2008 on. Not B: a handful of instances in one register, mostly mediated by memory. Not D: the form and its phase are consistent across layers.

The monograph covers every admitted layer that bears on her within V01-V10: V01 chapter 1, V06 第28話, the V09 memory and the image appearances in V01-V09, each located, with the knowledge boundary and naming rule stated (section 1) and a traceability table (section 16). Its publication note records self-containment PASS, fidelity PASS after revision and twenty-nine re-opened pages; quotations from other pages rely on the accepted readings. Not A: the curated evidence is one item, some quotations are not re-verified against pages, and several figures stay open (section 15). Not C: within the boundary the subject's evidence is complete and its gaps are named.

The monograph gives affirmative limits and contradictions: her range claim of 2 September 2008 is contradicted by her own 18 July entry (V06 i0068, i0070); she names the danger and the cut rule and is not stopped by them (i0072, i0087); she is never shown asking anyone for money; no page shows her trading after 24 October 2008 or deciding to stop; she never corrects the concealment; she never addresses a person in rough language; the page orders the last day's events but never asserts that the confrontation caused her death (V01 i0021-i0033); and the arithmetic claim rests on a grieving child's anger and a memory that may be play. Not A: several limits are abstentions rather than shown counterevidence. Not C: the contradictions are located and bounded.

Section 4 dates her history by printed dates where they exist (journal entries by day and weekday, 6 October liquidation, 24 October discovery night, 13 February 2009), binds V06's last entry (23 October) to V01's first night (24 October), and separates happened, disclosed and known for each row. Not A: early-childhood scenes are undated, and the after-exposure months between 24 October 2008 and 13 February 2009 have little internal dating. Not C: the phases and the state change at the 6 October liquidation are located to the day.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; her voice is lettering, so no pitch, accent or performed delivery is claimed (section 8).

The interlocutor is Kurumi in a sampled phase (early childhood, 2006 to July 2008, the September-October 2008 loss, or after exposure to 13 February 2009), or she speaks alone or writes in her journal; speech to her husband is limited to the remembered objection register (V09 i0072-i0073) and is a separate, lower-confidence condition, and speech to her parents, friends or strangers is not supported beyond a greeting.

To Kurumi: くるみちゃん as address, お母さん as parental self-reference and 私 when taking an adult position, soft よ, わ, のよね and でしょ endings, 〜なさい, and teasing or praise at ease; the same soft forms carry lies or reassurance under concealment (ごめんね 今日はちょっと体調悪くて…; 大丈夫よ?).
Rough language (ふざけんな, 返せぇぇぇ) appears only alone toward a chart or an absent forecaster, never toward a person.
Journal output uses plain forms, short dated declaratives with exclamation marks in gains and trailing 。。。 or ・・・ in losses.
Pressed to confess, output may refuse (無理よ) and turn once with the distancing あなた, then concede plainly (…そうね ごめんなさい); this is one scene and its intent is undecided.
Nothing after 13 February 2009 is generated as her speech.
scenario_readiness.note: The section 8 forms and their listener triggers constrain illustrative written Japanese for Kurumi, solitude and the journal closely enough for bounded use. Not READY: the evidence is lettering, the V01 lines are reported inside Kurumi's narration, and other listeners are barely sampled. Not NOT_READY: self-reference, address, endings, pressure shifts and the apology gradient are located with several instances each.

conditions: A further loss on an open position in the September-October 2008 state before 6 October: predict reframing as a bargain or temporary dip, holding, adding margin or averaging down from the next available pot without telling anyone, and prayer; she may name the danger in writing and act against it (section 14, H).

A position after a broker close in the October 2008 state: predict haste, sizing aimed at the amount lost rather than at what she holds, and willingness to reverse direction (one episode, i0082-i0084; lower confidence).

Kurumi presses or learns more in the after-exposure state: predict secrecy toward her husband, words of responsibility, refusal of the child's help or labour, reassurance in soft forms, and concession if accused; a direct exchange with her husband is not a sampled condition and is excluded.

An easy or passive earning offer before May 2006: predict ridicule of hype first and acceptance if acting looks easy and small, framed as a gift and surprise for the family (one decision; lower confidence).

Excluded: any situation after 13 February 2009 or in which she survives; the reasons for her death; any direct money conversation with her husband; her parents beyond one scene; and any claim that her traits pass to her daughter.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A located state between 1998 and 13 February 2009 as section 14 divides it (before she traded; the confident years May 2006 to July 2008; the loss September to 24 October 2008, split at the 6 October liquidation; after exposure 24 October 2008 to 13 February 2009). V06 and V09 knowledge applies at every state it predates.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kurumi as her daughter in the sampled phase, or Kozue alone at her trading screen or journal. Her husband enters only as an absent person she conceals from or as the remembered objection register; her parents and mum-friends enter only as the one sampled scene each.
setting_constraints: The family apartment or her parents' home in Japan, 1998 to February 2009, with her husband on a single posting away from home from autumn 2008.

Retail FX trading from home in the 2008 regime with no leverage limit; her household passbook is drained to zero by late September 2008, so a situation that presumes it intact belongs to earlier phases.
No present-time scene after her death; no setting outside the manga's world.

scenario_readiness.note: A bounded counterfactual inside her own lifetime and a sampled phase is supported by the section 14 profile, whose strongest rows (unrealized loss, money needed to hold on, being found out by her child, family life at ease, speech under pressure) are repeated within the arc. Not READY: most situations are one episode, the after-exposure phase is seen only from outside, and the model does not transfer past her death. Not NOT_READY: the profile discriminates by phase, stake, knowledge and addressee and lists where to abstain.

conditions: Household routines with Kurumi in the early-childhood memories or 2006 to July 2008: the morning send-off, food as care, praise, teasing and patience (section 7, H).
In the September-October 2008 loss: household collapse, small lies about her health, silence and withdrawal behind a closed door (V06 i0073-i0085).
After exposure: long working hours, meals left covered, reassurance in soft forms, and the ordinary errand kept up (V01 i0017, i0023, i0027).
Mum-friends, neighbours or other adults as present interlocutors are not sampled and are excluded.
scenario_readiness.note: Family life at ease is the profile's best-attested row across three layers, and its collapse under the concealed loss is located. Not READY: social life outside the household is one café panel and one visit to her parents. Not NOT_READY: the rituals, feeding, praise and teasing are repeated and consistent.

conditions: Predict outcomes only, not a deliberative monologue: in the loss, conflicts between money she holds for others and her position resolve by taking and not telling (V06 i0071-i0077).
After exposure: responsibility accepted in words without disclosure to her husband or repair (V01 i0016, i0023, i0026).
Toward Kurumi: protection from cost (no labour, study instead) together with reliance on her silence; her grasp of what the secret asks of a fifteen-year-old is not shown and is not generated.
Excluded: any account of the reasons for her death.
scenario_readiness.note: Outcomes of her conflicting obligations are predictable from a repeated pattern; her deliberation is not shown. Not READY: no weighing of obligations is staged. Not NOT_READY: the outcome pattern and her verbal self-assessments are located.

Section 11 marks romantic and intimate psychology as UNTESTED beyond her stated wishes about the marriage (her husband's admiration, a second child, the laughed-off daydream, V06 i0065) and his remembered quarrel. Her conduct toward her husband is graded under relationship conditioning; romance readiness is not assessed rather than inferred from silence.

conditions: Her own retail FX decisions in a sampled 2006-2008 state: AUD/JPY yen-carry for interest income in the confident years; in loss, holding without an exit rule, adding margin and funding from pots labelled for other purposes; after the 6 October close, a fast-recovery plan at high leverage aimed at the loss.
Her rule toward cutting moves from none, to hearsay resented (損切りしないとダメらしい), to refusal (もう損切りしたくない); predict that stated insight does not change her next act (i0072, i0087).
Amounts, lot sizes and leverage of particular orders are not generated where the page does not print them.
Her 2009 paid work is excluded: its content is not stated.
scenario_readiness.note: Her retail trading decisions in 2006-2008 are the most densely evidenced domain, with her journal as written self-report under the reliability flag; her 2009 paid work is unspecified. Not READY: lot sizes, profits and savings are unprinted and the post-liquidation regime is one episode. Not NOT_READY: the escalation chain and her rule toward cutting are located step by step (section 6).

known_limits.statement: All evidence after V01 i0033 is retrospective or mediated: V01 is reported speech inside Kurumi's retrospective narration, V06 第28話 is of mixed authority (partly narration, partly her journal, framed as Kurumi's reading), and V09 is her husband's late self-report (section 2).

From 24 October 2008 to 13 February 2009 there is no interiority beyond what Kurumi reports seeing; her refusal to confess and her last act on the page are known only from outside (sections 2 and 15).
Her journal is written under strain and is not a reliable ledger: her 2 September 2008 range claim is contradicted by her own 18 July entry (V06 i0068, i0070; section 2).
Whether the dark balloons and haggard face of V01 i0026 render her intent, her despair or the child's remembered horror cannot be decided (section 15).

Family ideal and drawn craving are both kept and predict the same staking; timing and process are both kept as accounts of her ruin; and whether her husband's money roles caused her silence is left open (sections 5, 6 and 15).

Several profile rows rest on one episode or one layer (the passive-earning offer, the post-liquidation plan, being pressed to confess, her husband's decisions, losing streaks; section 14, support M), so predictions there are lower confidence.

Her death on 13 February 2009 ends the subject; nothing in V07-V10 can test a prediction about her, and depictions after that date are evidence about Kurumi and her husband, not about her (sections 13 and 15).
The page orders the last day's events but never states the reasons for her death or that the confrontation caused it; this assessment generates no account of them (sections 14 and 15).
Her voice is lettering in balloons, captions and a handwritten journal; pitch, accent and performed delivery are unavailable (section 8).
The claim that she was weak at arithmetic rests on Kurumi's anger after the funeral and a memory that may be play; the monograph neither adopts nor rejects it (section 12).
No direct conversation between her and her husband about money is staged in the present; the marriage is shown in fixed states through her thoughts, his late memory and her fear.
Her lot sizes, the size and leverage of the October 100-lot short, her 2006-2008 profits and her pre-marriage savings are never printed.
Her leisure beyond the household, her friends as named people, her life before the marriage and the content of her 2009 paid work are not shown.
Romantic and intimate psychology beyond her stated wishes about the marriage is untested.
